title: Roll third turn with low cash
description: Roll third turn with low cash. Roll first because cash is scarce even though exit may be forced after failure. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.private_thought: Cash is low; paying 50 would cripple buying houses. Rolling for doubles gives a chance to stay cash-rich. Risk of staying in jail another turn is acceptable.

breakdown.message: Uses jail as defense rather than voluntarily spending cash.
Preserves the full cash reserve by rolling.
